Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

The document supports undoable RemovePanel, but no MovePanel command or UI control appears; AddPanel still only appends/chooses a first free letter.

Evidence:
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/command/Reducer.scala:481 implements RemovePanel
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/figures/AddPanel.scala:108-165 only constructs added panels and next free letters
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/command/Command.scala:1 current commands

Remaining / next action: Add keyboard-reachable remove/reorder UI, an undoable move command, and convert golden journey creation path.

Disposition: Keep open.
